text: しってるだろ　ドラゴンは　せいなる　でんせつの　いきものだ！

structure.jp: せいなる　でんせつの　いきものだ！

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end asks the listener to agree: 'right?'. だろ is the clipped spoken form. しってるだろ = 'you know, don't you?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows a lasting state: knowing is always said this way. てる is the short spoken form. しってる = 'you know'.
